tts_gate_policy: Maximum RTF across all EOS-verified complete generations with throughput/fused decoders: three Serena repetitions, nine voices twice, cancellation recovery and English twice. Includes the first request after each load; excludes the deliberately cancelled partial generation.
sanitization: Removed ready payloads and request UUIDs; output audio paths contain only the experiment directory and filename. Transcripts, timings, hashes and SDK stop reasons are unchanged.
audio_files: Generated WAV and PCM are retained under ignored artifacts/coreml/<experiment-directory>/. Public corpus audio can be regenerated from corpus.json and the verified immutable Parquet sources.
